correctness.rationale: The bond/deletion equivalence classes are contiguous consecutive-value monotone runs, so sphere volume equals n minus bond count. Splitting Av(132) around the maximum with matching starting/ending maximum endpoint equations gives the exact quadratic. Differentiation yields the rational exact mean. The simple discriminant root at z=1/4, with rho prime -3/32 and rho double prime 49/512, yields nondegenerate analytic quasi-powers and variance 17n/128+O(1). Standard-library exhaustive source/deletion and coefficient checks passed through n=8; Catalan marginal and exact mean checks passed through n=12; these finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: Full inspection of the most relevant pre-2016 132-avoiding one-box article shows that it enumerates positions incident to a bond, not the total number of bond edges, which differs on 1234 versus 2134. The 2016 prolific permutation theorem characterizes maximal deletion sphere volume rather than its complete Av(132) distribution or CLT. Related marked mesh and big-descent results use different statistics. The numerical two-bond column is already catalogued and is expressly not claimed novel. The full algebraic sphere-volume enumerator, its exact mean, and 17/128 Gaussian fluctuation coefficient were not found in inspected sources or comparable published mathematical searches; implicit unindexed equivalence is a residual risk.
